name: Starter imagery
_note: Pictures every project has offline, in two kinds. (1) A CURATED STOCK LIBRARY of 44 CC0/public-domain photographs — grounds, work, people, food, animals, surfaces and avatars — fetched from Wikimedia Commons with each file's licence read individually and recorded in LICENCES.json beside them. They are already cropped for the shape they are for: `ground-*` and `texture-*` are 16:9 band grounds, everything else is a 4:3 tile, and `avatar-*` are 256px squares framed on the face. (2) Six ABSTRACT SVG placeholders (ground-*, tile-*, portrait.svg) kept from the first version: hue-neutral, ~6 KB, and the thing to reach for when no photograph is honest about the subject. Reference any file as noodl_modules/starter-imagery/<name> from an Image src or a Group backgroundImage. This module carries no stylesheet and injects nothing. The photographs are CC0: no attribution is required and there is no restriction on redistributing them inside an app you deploy.
